Interpretation: The client actively searches for the previously saved network profile.
The AP advertises the baseline security configuration to the client.
The client initiates IEEE 802.11 authentication with the AP.
The AP accepts the client's authentication request.
The client requests association using the advertised baseline security configuration.
The AP accepts the association request and allows the client to proceed.
The AP initiates the WPA2 4-Way Handshake.
The client proves possession of the Pairwise Master Key and participates in key derivation.
The AP distributes group key material and instructs the client to install session keys.
The client confirms key installation and completes the 4-Way Handshake.
